## 3. Historical event date

The event date **01-Mar-2018** is supported by both the exact attachment filename and the repeated page caption. The repeated caption names **José Acosta Matos** and characterises the entry as “ilegal” and as forcing the staff door.

The repository records that wording as **source wording**, not as a judicial finding.

## 4. Joan Cruz attribution boundary

The exact source filename expressly associates **Joan Cruz** with the 01-Mar-2018 evidence package. The page captions themselves, however, name José Acosta Matos. The project therefore does **not** convert the filename into a stronger factual proposition than the source supports.

No facial recognition is used. This record does not claim from the photographs alone that Joan Cruz is depicted, nor does it establish his conduct, knowledge, authority, coordination, or criminal responsibility.

Publication-safe caption rule for any derivative image from this sequence:

> “The source document attributes the persons shown to José Acosta Matos/CAM and Joan Cruz; independent identity authentication remains outstanding.”

## 5. Identity resolution and Meeting Point chronology

Public professional material resolves the person as **Joan Cruz Nuez**. Public reporting states that he ceased performing the CEO role at Meeting Point Hotel Management on **01-Nov-2017**.

Official BORME records add a primary-source corporate chronology:

- **03-Dec-2015:** `MEETING POINT HOTELMANAGEMENT (CANARIES), S.L.` — Joan Cruz Nuez recorded among joint attorneys (`Apo.Manc.`), I/A 5.
- **26-Jul-2016:** the same company records a further joint-attorney appointment including Joan Cruz Nuez, I/A 6.
- **19-Feb-2016:** `MEETING POINT INVESTMENT, S.L.` records Joan Cruz Nuez among joint attorneys, I/A 3.
- **05-Feb-2019:** BORME records revocation of Joan Cruz Nuez among joint attorneys of both Meeting Point Hotelmanagement (Canaries) and Meeting Point Investment.
- **27-Feb-2025:** a later BORME entry again lists Joan Cruz Nuez among a broader set of joint attorneys revoked at Meeting Point Hotelmanagement (Canaries). This later registry entry is retained as a **reconciliation point**; it is not used to infer that a particular 2015/2016 power remained continuously operative after the 2019 revocation.

That makes 01-Mar-2018 a date after the reported CEO departure but within a period in which the BORME record still showed identified Meeting Point powers before the 05-Feb-2019 revocations. This is chronology only: it does not prove that he invoked or exercised those powers at Sun Park.

## 6. Relation to 07-Jun-2018

The 01-Mar-2018 event precedes the separately documented 07-Jun-2018 Sun Park control/takeover event by **98 days**. It is therefore registered as an earlier operational-control chronology node and must be read together with, but not collapsed into, the 07-Jun-2018 dossier.

## 7. Later public context

- **19-Nov-2021:** published Hosteltur material identifies Joan Cruz among Tusity's partners and separately identifies Grupo Acosta Matos among businesses supported by Tusity. This is later commercial context, not proof of 2018 coordination.
- **23-Apr-2025:** CNMC authorised Portobello Capital, through Gestora Blue Sea Partner / BLUESEA, to acquire exclusive control of `MEETING POINT SPAIN, S.L.U.` and its subsidiaries (`C/1549/25 BLUE SEA / MPS`).
- **08-Aug-2025:** Tourinews reports BLUESEA engaging Cruz to direct the absorption of Meeting Point Hotels Spain and renew management contracts approaching expiry.
- **Sep-2025 public activity:** Joan Cruz's public LinkedIn profile preserves/shares items concerning a renewed Meeting Point hotel contract at Hotel Alyssa Suite in Playa Blanca with BLUESEA support and the entrustment of Hotel Marieta by Acosta Matos to Meeting Point/BLUESEA. These are professional self-publication/context signals, not evidence of a 2018 agreement.

## 9. Commercial/professional continuity — classified propositions

### 1. DOCUMENTED FACT

- The controlled 01-Mar-2018 package expressly associates Joan Cruz by filename with the Sun Park photographic sequence, subject to the attribution boundary above.
- The recovered HKI original screenshots dated **25-Nov-2019** show `Sun Park (Lanzarote)` on HKI Hotels' projects page and Joan Cruz on HKI Hotels' team page.
- The controlled archive contains later Club Sei Lanzarote commercial captures and the already-canonical Sun Park → Lava Verde → Club Sei chronology.

### 2. PRIMARY-SOURCE CORPORATE / REGULATORY RECORD

- BORME records Joan Cruz Nuez as a joint attorney in Meeting Point Hotelmanagement (Canaries) from 2015/2016 and Meeting Point Investment from 2016, with 05-Feb-2019 revocations.
- CNMC `C/1549/25 BLUE SEA / MPS` records Portobello Capital, through Gestora Blue Sea Partner / BLUESEA, acquiring exclusive control of Meeting Point Spain and its subsidiaries in 2025.

### 3. CONTEMPORANEOUS MEDIA / PROFESSIONAL SELF-PUBLICATION

- A 23-Aug-2016 report of the LABRANDA Hotels & Resorts–Meeting Point Cup at **Hotel LABRANDA Marieta** identifies Joan Cruz as **Director General of LABRANDA Hotels & Resorts**.
- Acosta Matos's own project archive identifies **Hotel Labranda Marieta** as a Grupo Patrimonial Acosta Matos, S.L. asset and identifies José D. Acosta Matos as architect.
- Acosta Matos's own project archive identifies its **Meeting Point Vecindario** central-office refurbishment as operated by Meeting Point Hotel Management S.L. and designed by José D. Acosta Matos.
- Acosta Matos's own **Hotel Lava Verde** page places the 279-room project at **C/ Janubio 3, Playa Blanca** and identifies Construcciones Acosta Matos S.A. as owner and José D. Acosta Matos as architect; the operator field is blank.
- 2019 trade reporting identifies Club Sei Lanzarote as one of the first properties planned for Meeting Point Hotels' new Club Sei brand within FTI Group. Later reporting records postponement of the Club Sei rollout in Oct-2020.

### 4. CORROBORATED CONNECTION

Reading the independent source families together supports a **pre-2018 recurring owner–operator–executive relationship** rather than an isolated first contact:

1. Joan Cruz was already a Meeting Point/LABRANDA executive and registered Meeting Point attorney in 2015–2017.
2. In Aug-2016 he is publicly documented at Hotel LABRANDA Marieta as LABRANDA director general.
3. Acosta Matos identifies Grupo Patrimonial Acosta Matos as owner of the Marieta project.
4. Acosta Matos separately documents professional work for Meeting Point's Gran Canaria central offices.
5. In 2025 Acosta Matos again publicly entrusts Marieta to Meeting Point with BLUESEA support, after the BLUESEA/Meeting Point control transaction; Cruz's public profile shares that development.

This establishes commercial/professional **continuity and familiarity worthy of investigation**. It does **not** establish that the 01-Mar-2018 Sun Park visit was authorised by Meeting Point, undertaken for a future Club Sei project, coordinated unlawfully, or part of any criminal agreement.

### 5. INVESTIGATIVE INFERENCE / HYPOTHESIS

The 01-Mar-2018 Sun Park episode is better tested as a node inside a longer Canary hospitality relationship than as a free-standing encounter. The chronology makes it reasonable to investigate whether the visit related to hotel evaluation, technical/project preparation, owner/operator discussions, measurements, future management or commercialisation.

The working sequence remains:

`Sun Park → Acosta Matos “Lava Verde” → Meeting Point/FTI “Club Sei Lanzarote”`

and the human/corporate continuity route:

`Joan Cruz → Meeting Point / LABRANDA → HKI Hotels → BLUESEA / Meeting Point continuity`

These are investigative routes, not findings of common purpose or criminal coordination.

### 6. USER ALLEGATION

The project/user alleges a wider causal relationship between pre-title access/project preparation, the later change in material control, commercialisation and adjudication. That allegation remains separately labelled in the existing Sun Park/Lava Verde/Club Sei dossiers and is not upgraded by this continuity record.

### 7. UNRESOLVED / REQUIRES AUTHENTICATION

Still unresolved:

- independent identity authentication for the people depicted in the 01-Mar photographs;
- exact consent, title, authority, manner and purpose of access on 01-Mar-2018;
- Joan Cruz's exact capacity, if any, for Meeting Point, HKI or another party on that date;
- original image files, EXIF/device data, photographer/custodian and complete sequence;
- who requested the visit and the agenda/communications surrounding it;
- whether measurements, plans, photographs, inventories or condition reports were produced and where they went;
- earliest provable creation/publication date of the Lava Verde concept beyond the controlled repository milestone;
- first publication date of the HKI Sun Park project page before the preserved 25-Nov-2019 screenshot;
- exact Meeting Point/FTI legal entity, contract, LOI, mandate, inventory, bookings, payments or revenue route for Sun Park/Lava Verde/Club Sei;
- whether any Sun Park/Lava Verde/Club Sei project material appears in Meeting Point/FTI/BLUESEA handover, insolvency or 357/2024 files;
- reconciliation of the 2019 and 2025 BORME revocation entries without assuming continuous power after 2019;
- Annex 08-D hash/page equivalence to the predecessor PDF.

## 10. Why this node matters

Joan Cruz matters to the evidence graph **not simply because his name is attached to one photographic sequence**. The stronger documentary question is whether a longer-running owner–operator–developer relationship—Meeting Point/FTI/LABRANDA, HKI, Acosta Matos hospitality assets and later BLUESEA/Meeting Point continuity—can explain the commercial context, knowledge and project preparation surrounding the Sun Park → Lava Verde → Club Sei sequence.

The correct investigative output is therefore a chronology and custody problem: identify who knew the property, under what professional capacity, when project work began, what records were produced, which entity held them and how custody moved. It is not a shortcut to criminal attribution.

## 11. Publication boundary

Public publication is limited to canonical identity, dates, filename, hash, page count, neutral source description, publication-safe corporate/professional chronology, source-wording quotation status and evidential guardrails. Private email bodies, addresses and other mailbox metadata are not published by this record.

The Annex 08-D binary is not committed by this worker delta. Existing public HKI screenshot derivatives remain the only Joan/HKI visual evidence already cleared and published on the canonical actor page.
